extracted.intended_audience: academics who write, review, or edit journal articles (including early-career researchers)
extracted.subtask_description: Practical guidance and norms for authors, reviewers and editors on recognizing, responding to, and preventing abusive or unprofessional peer-review behaviour. Includes sample bad comments, author response options, reviewer norms, and systemic fixes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid abusive/personal comments
rubrics_metrics.description: "This work is useless. Nothing is presented."; "The author writes like a drunken after-dinner speaker."; reviews in ALL CAPS stating someone "should never be allowed to publish."; comments described as "rude, obnoxious, verging on abusive, and personal."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These are presented as real examples of unacceptable reviewer behaviour. Such comments are unprofessional and can be grounds for author complaint or editorial intervention.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact the editor about unjust feedback
rubrics_metrics.description: Contact the editor to lodge a complaint about unjust feedback.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as an author-side response option when reviewer comments are unfair or abusive.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consider withdrawing the paper
rubrics_metrics.description: Consider withdrawing the paper if comments are sufficiently damaging.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors may choose withdrawal as a response to particularly damaging or unjust reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recognize reviewers can be wrong
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognize "academics can be brutal and also wrong."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors should keep perspective: harsh reviews are not always correct; use this recognition to inform response strategy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Share experiences with early-career researchers
rubrics_metrics.description: Share these stories with early-career researchers for perspective.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use real examples to mentor and set expectations for ECRs about variability and potential harshness in peer review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stay within your expertise area
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed under reviewer norms (Alastair Sloan) as a core expectation for reviewers: decline or limit scope if outside your expertise.

rubrics_metrics.name: Actually read the manuscript thoroughly
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewers should not give superficial or off-base comments; thorough reading is an explicit norm.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dedicate adequate time to reviews
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewers are expected to invest sufficient time to provide considered, constructive feedback rather than rushed judgments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Remain impartial throughout
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewers should avoid personal or disciplinary bias and evaluate the manuscript on its merits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Facilitate scholarly conversation, not be adversarial
rubrics_metrics.description: Focus on "facilitating" scholarly conversation rather than adopting "an adversarial role."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewer stance should be constructive and aimed at improving work and discourse, not attacking authors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Increase transparency in peer review (publish reviewer comments)
rubrics_metrics.description: More transparent peer-review processes (publish reviewer comments publicly).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented as a systemic solution to curb abusive behaviour and improve accountability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Improve editorial oversight of comment tone
rubrics_metrics.description: Better editorial oversight of comment tone.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Editors should monitor and intervene when reviewers' tone is unprofessional; authors are advised to contact editors when needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Protect editor time in workload models
rubrics_metrics.description: Protect editor time in university workload models.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Systemic recommendation: give editors institutional support/time to manage reviews and oversee reviewer behaviour.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compensate reviewers appropriately
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Suggested systemic change to value reviewing work and potentially improve review quality and accountability.
